description: Everything the update window needs, and nothing the main window can reach.
comment: Scoped to the update window by label on purpose. `withGlobalTauri` injects the API object into
every window, including the main one — which renders dsh's own web UI, code this project does
not own. Granting nothing there leaves that object inert: the ACL refuses the call regardless
Only events are granted. Commands defined by this app are not ACL-gated, and the window asks
